testedRevision: 5a01e2b plus the Auth hashing fix in this commit
stack: Docker Compose project tm-lb from npm run demo, every service one container except Tutor, Traefik gateway
host: MacBook, 12 CPUs, Docker VM 7.75 GiB, k6 on the same host
replicas: Tutor ran as 1 and then 3 containers (docker compose up --scale tutor-service=3). All other services ran as one container.
resourceLimits: Tutor is capped at 0.5 CPU per replica by compose.yaml. Other services are uncapped.
loadBalancing: Share of Tutor traffic per replica, from each container's network receive bytes before and after the run: steady 33/33/33%, stress 33/33/33%.

excludedRuns.cold-start-1-replica-steady: First run after the stack started: 6.5% errors while caches and JIT were cold. The same test passed with 0% errors once warm. Kept for honesty; not used in the table.
excludedRuns.invalid-slept-3-replica-stress: The laptop suspended for about 15 minutes during this run, so one request took 15 minutes. Rerun under caffeinate; this file is not valid.

warmUp: Every measured run is preceded by a 10 s, 10 user warm-up.
failover: kill-one-replica: one of three Tutor replicas was stopped 10 s into a 30 s steady run: 23 of 23061 requests failed (HTTP 502 and 504), all within about 5 s, then Traefik routed to the other two.
